name: DREO Atom One
summary: A 10 in cube-shaped ceramic heater with a digital thermostat and a remote, around $50 at DREO's list price. Family Handyman and CNN Underscored both found it heats a small room, but in Family Handyman's test it took about two minutes to shut off after it was knocked over, and CNN measured 50 dB at its loudest.
idealFor: Heating one person at a desk, with someone in the room
pros: Raised Family Handyman's test room from 72°F to 80°F on low
Digital thermostat in 1°F steps, 70° oscillation and a remote at a budget price
Stable, cube-shaped body; CNN found the grille wasn't scorching
cons: Took about two minutes to shut off after being tipped over (Family Handyman)
Loudest pick here: 50 dB in CNN Underscored's test
1-year warranty, and DREO recalled a different heater on Oct 29, 2026

trust.summary: Only two independent hands-on tests so far, and both agree it heats a small room. DREO publishes dimensions and weight, but CNN measured 50 dB against the 37.5 dB claim. It also loses points for DREO's October 2026 recall of another heater, an unverified UL or ETL listing, no declared materials or warnings and a 1-year warranty.

sources.title: Family Handyman: The 6 safest space heaters, tested and reviewed
sources.note: Best budget. Sydney Manning: 72°F to 80°F on low, then 80°F to 88°F on high; cool to the touch after use; when set on its side it beeped at once but took about two minutes to shut off; no cord management

sources.title: CNN Underscored: The best space heaters
sources.note: Tested, not a top pick: +9°F in 30 min; 90°F on highest; 50 dB at its loudest; grille not scorching; stable cube shape
